answer: Standing decays three percent per epoch an identity does not answer. Duplicate submission forfeits the entire bond. Decay applies before payout, so a lazy account pays first and earns second. A farm that answers every third epoch keeps forty percent of its score and eats a full bond on each duplication. Work the ridge or lose it. The pearl is not free, and one voyage through the archive that repeats an answer twice ends both the bond and the account.
